import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/test_3.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold the unique video paths from each source
    video_paths = []

    # Load each source file, extract the 'video' column, and collect unique values
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Extract unique video paths from this source
        unique_videos = df['video'].dropna().unique()
        video_paths.extend(unique_videos)

    # Deduplicate all collected video paths
    unique_video_paths = sorted(set(video_paths))

    # Create the target DataFrame with the required schema ['video']
    target_df = pd.DataFrame(unique_video_paths, columns=['video'])

    # Write the target DataFrame to the specified CSV file
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_89/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
